plan.title: 90-Day Fresher Tech Roadmap
plan.subtitle: DSA + Full Stack + AI/ML + Cloud (GCP/AWS) + System Design

phases.title: Core Foundations (Priority Intensive)
phases.focus: DSA, Full Stack Basics, System Design fundamentals — daily grind

phases.title: Advanced + AI/ML + Cloud Deep Dive
phases.focus: Advanced DSA, AI/ML, Cloud, Behavioral Prep — finishing touches

legend.daily: Every day — core priority skills (DSA, Full Stack, System Design)
legend.priority: 3x/week — important but secondary (AI/ML, Cloud, DevOps, CS fundamentals)
legend.weekly: 1-2x/week — good to know, rounds out profile

topics.subject: DSA
topics.topic: Arrays — basics, traversal, Big O Notation
topics.what_to_learn: Understand arrays in memory, time/space complexity (O(1), O(n), O(n²)), basic array operations: insert, delete, search. Practice: reverse array, find max/min, two-pointer intro.
topics.practice: Solve: Two Sum, Best Time to Buy/Sell Stock, Contains Duplicate

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Learn HTML5 semantic tags (header, main, nav, footer, article, section), CSS box model, flexbox, basic selectors and specificity.
topics.practice: Build a basic personal profile card using HTML/CSS

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: String immutability, common operations (substring, charAt, split, join), sliding window technique introduction. Anagram check, palindrome check.
topics.practice: Solve: Valid Anagram, Longest Common Prefix, Reverse String

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: var vs let vs const, arrow functions, template literals, for/while loops, array methods (map, filter, reduce). Understand how JS runs in the browser.
topics.practice: Write JS functions: FizzBuzz, factorial, palindrome checker

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: How hash tables work internally (hashing function, collisions, chaining, open addressing). Use cases: counting frequency, deduplication, O(1) lookup. When to use Map vs Set vs Object in JS.
topics.practice: Solve: Group Anagrams, Top K Frequent Elements, Valid Sudoku

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: querySelector, addEventListener, createElement, innerHTML vs textContent. Event bubbling & capturing. Form validation. Building interactive pages.
topics.practice: Build a simple to-do list with add/delete in vanilla JS

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: The two-pointer technique: left/right pointers on sorted arrays. Variants: same direction (slow/fast pointer), opposite direction. Use cases: pair sum, removing duplicates, container with most water.
topics.practice: Solve: Valid Palindrome, Two Sum II, 3Sum, Container With Most Water

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: CSS Grid layout system: grid-template-columns, grid-template-rows, gap, grid-area. Media queries for responsive design. Mobile-first approach.
topics.practice: Recreate a 3-column card layout, make it responsive for mobile

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Fixed-size and variable-size sliding windows. When to expand/shrink window. Max sum subarray of size k, longest substring without repeating characters.
topics.practice: Solve: Longest Substring Without Repeating, Minimum Window Substring, Best Time to Buy Stock

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Event loop, call stack, callback queue. Promise chaining (.then, .catch, .finally). async/await syntax. Fetch API for HTTP requests. Error handling with try/catch.
topics.practice: Fetch data from a public API (e.g. JSONPlaceholder) and display it on a webpage

topics.subject: CS Fundamentals
topics.what_to_learn: Process vs Thread. Context switching. CPU scheduling (FCFS, SJF, Round Robin). Inter-process communication (pipes, shared memory). Memory layout (stack, heap). This is common in interviews.
topics.practice: Read about deadlocks — four conditions (Mutual Exclusion, Hold and Wait, No Preemption, Circular Wait)

topics.subject: Cloud (GCP)
topics.what_to_learn: GCP vs AWS vs Azure — what differentiates them. GCP resource hierarchy (Organization → Folder → Project). Key services: Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Cloud Run. IAM basics — roles and permissions.
topics.practice: Create a free GCP account. Explore the console. Enable Compute Engine API.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Stack (push, pop, peek, isEmpty). Queue (enqueue, dequeue). Deque (double-ended). Monotonic stack — when to use. Call stack analogy. Practical uses: undo operations, BFS, balanced parentheses.
topics.practice: Solve: Valid Parentheses, Min Stack, Daily Temperatures, Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Git init, clone, add, commit, push, pull, branch, merge, rebase. .gitignore. Pull requests. Merge conflicts. git log and git diff. This is non-negotiable for any dev job.
topics.practice: Create a GitHub repo, push your to-do list project, make a branch, and open a PR

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Node structure (data + next pointer). Singly vs doubly linked list. Operations: insert head/tail, delete, search, reverse. Fast/slow pointer for cycle detection (Floyd's Tortoise & Hare).
topics.practice: Solve: Reverse Linked List, Merge Two Sorted Lists, Linked List Cycle, Middle of Linked List

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.topic: Node.js Introduction — modules, npm, file system
topics.what_to_learn: What is Node.js and why it matters (server-side JS). require vs import. npm: package.json, installing packages, scripts. Built-in modules: fs, path, os. Event-driven architecture.
topics.practice: Write a Node.js script that reads a file, transforms its content, and writes to a new file

topics.subject: DSA
topics.topic: Linked List Advanced — LRU Cache, merge k sorted
topics.what_to_learn: LRU Cache design using HashMap + Doubly Linked List. Merge K sorted lists using min-heap. Copy list with random pointer. Remove Nth node from end.
topics.practice: Solve: LRU Cache, Merge K Sorted Lists, Copy List with Random Pointer

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: What is Express? Routing (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE). Middleware concept. Request/Response objects. Route parameters and query strings. Postman for API testing. Status codes (200, 201, 400, 404, 500).
topics.practice: Build a basic REST API with Express: GET /users, POST /users, DELETE /users/:id

topics.subject: CS Fundamentals
topics.what_to_learn: Relational model, primary/foreign keys. Normalization (1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF). Transactions and ACID properties (Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability). Indexing basics. SQL joins review.
topics.practice: Design a schema for a library management system. Normalize it to 3NF.

topics.subject: Cloud (GCP)
topics.topic: GCP Storage — Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Firestore
topics.what_to_learn: Cloud Storage: buckets, objects, access control, storage classes (Standard, Nearline, Coldline). Cloud SQL (managed PostgreSQL/MySQL). Firestore (NoSQL document DB). When to use which.
topics.practice: Create a GCS bucket, upload a file, set it public, access it via URL. Enable Cloud SQL and connect.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Binary search on sorted array — O(log n). Left/right boundary binary search. Binary search on answer space (not array). Key insight: when to use binary search on a monotonic function.
topics.practice: Solve: Binary Search, Search a 2D Matrix, Find Min in Rotated Sorted Array, Koko Eating Bananas

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Document model vs relational. Collections and documents. CRUD operations with Mongoose. Schema design. Indexing in MongoDB. When to use MongoDB vs SQL.
topics.practice: Set up MongoDB Atlas (free tier), create a DB, insert/query documents using Mongoose

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Search in rotated sorted array. Find peak element. Median of two sorted arrays. Capacity to ship packages (binary search on answer). Aggressive cows / book allocation pattern.
topics.practice: Solve: Search in Rotated Sorted Array, Find Peak Element, Split Array Largest Sum

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Why React? Component-based architecture. JSX syntax. Props: passing data parent to child. Component reusability. React dev tools. Functional components (class components are legacy).
topics.practice: Build a static React page with a Navbar, HeroSection, and Cards components using props

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Tree terminology (root, leaf, height, depth). Binary tree vs BST. DFS traversals: inorder, preorder, postorder (recursive and iterative). Level-order (BFS) using queue. Inverting a tree.
topics.practice: Solve: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree, Invert Binary Tree, Symmetric Tree, Level Order Traversal

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: State management with useState. Side effects with useEffect (fetching data, subscriptions, cleanup). Dependency array. Controlled vs uncontrolled inputs. Conditional rendering.
topics.practice: Build a weather app that fetches from Open-Meteo API. Display current temp and condition.

topics.subject: System Design
topics.topic: System Design Basics — scalability, availability, reliability
topics.what_to_learn: What system design interviews look for. Scalability (vertical vs horizontal). Availability (nines: 99.9%, 99.99%). Reliability vs availability. Load balancing concepts (round robin, least connections, hash). CAP theorem basics.
topics.practice: Design a URL shortener system on paper: components needed, data flow, how it handles load

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.topic: AI/ML Landscape — what companies actually use
topics.what_to_learn: Difference between AI, ML, Deep Learning, Generative AI. Supervised vs Unsupervised vs Reinforcement Learning. What LLMs are (GPT, Claude, Gemini). APIs vs local models. Why ML skills matter for SWE roles in 2025.
topics.practice: Write a short notes doc: 5 real company use cases of ML (Netflix recommendations, Google Search, Fraud detection, etc.)

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: BST properties (left < root < right). Search, insert, delete in BST — O(log n) average. Lowest Common Ancestor. Validate BST. Kth smallest in BST. AVL tree concept (why balancing matters).
topics.practice: Solve: Validate BST, Kth Smallest in BST, LCA of BST, Insert into BST

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: RESTful conventions: resource naming, HTTP verbs, statelessness. Request/response headers. Authentication headers (Authorization: Bearer). Pagination (offset vs cursor). Error response structure. API versioning.
topics.practice: Add proper error handling, pagination (limit/skip), and authentication middleware to your Express API

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Heap data structure. Min-heap vs max-heap. Heap operations: insert O(log n), extract-min O(log n), peek O(1). Heapify. K largest/smallest elements. Merge k sorted lists with heap. Python heapq / Java PriorityQueue.
topics.practice: Solve: Kth Largest Element in Array, Last Stone Weight, K Closest Points to Origin, Find Median from Data Stream

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: SQL deep dive: complex JOINs (INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL), GROUP BY, HAVING, subqueries, CTEs. Indexing (B-tree, HASH). Transactions in PostgreSQL. Using pg (node-postgres) with Node.js.
topics.practice: Create a PostgreSQL DB for a blog: posts, users, comments. Write JOIN queries and use transactions.

topics.subject: CS Fundamentals
topics.what_to_learn: OSI model layers (Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application). TCP vs UDP. HTTP vs HTTPS. DNS resolution. How a request goes from browser to server. Ports and sockets. Common interview questions on networking.
topics.practice: Trace what happens when you type 'google.com' in the browser — write it step by step (DNS → TCP → HTTP → HTML rendering)

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.what_to_learn: REST-based LLM APIs. API keys, rate limits, tokens (prompt + completion). System prompts vs user messages. Temperature and max_tokens parameters. Streaming responses. Building a simple chatbot with the API.
topics.practice: Build a CLI chatbot using the OpenAI (or free Gemini) API — multi-turn conversation with message history

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Graph representations: adjacency matrix vs adjacency list. Directed vs undirected. Weighted vs unweighted. BFS (level-by-level, shortest path in unweighted). DFS (exploring all paths, cycle detection). Visited array to avoid infinite loops.
topics.practice: Solve: Number of Islands, Clone Graph, Max Area of Island, Flood Fill

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Authentication vs Authorization. Session-based vs token-based (JWT). JWT structure (header.payload.signature). bcrypt for password hashing. Implementing register/login/protected routes. Refresh tokens concept.
topics.practice: Add JWT auth to your Express API — register, login, protect a route with middleware

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Dijkstra's algorithm with priority queue — O((V+E)logV) for non-negative weights. Bellman-Ford — handles negative weights, O(VE). When to use which. BFS for unweighted shortest path.
topics.practice: Solve: Network Delay Time, Cheapest Flights Within K Stops, Path With Minimum Effort

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Prop drilling problem. Context API as global state solution. createContext, useContext. useReducer for complex state logic (action/reducer pattern — like Redux but simpler). When to use Context vs Redux vs Zustand.
topics.practice: Build a shopping cart with Context + useReducer — add/remove/update quantities

days.title: System Design Deep Dive + GCP Compute

topics.subject: System Design
topics.topic: Databases in System Design — SQL vs NoSQL, sharding, replication
topics.what_to_learn: SQL vs NoSQL trade-offs in large systems. Read replicas for scaling reads. Sharding (horizontal partitioning) for scaling writes. Consistent hashing for distributing data. Database denormalization in high-scale systems.

resources.name: Alex Xu System Design Interview Book

topics.practice: Design Twitter's data model: what DB would you use for tweets vs followers vs media? Explain sharding strategy.

topics.subject: Cloud (GCP)
topics.topic: GCP Compute — Compute Engine, Cloud Run, App Engine
topics.what_to_learn: Compute Engine: VMs, machine types, persistent disks, preemptible VMs. Cloud Run: containerized apps, auto-scaling to zero, serverless. App Engine: fully managed, for web apps. When to use each.
topics.practice: Deploy a simple Node.js app to Cloud Run using a Docker container. Test the public URL.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Topological sort — for DAGs (Directed Acyclic Graphs). Kahn's algorithm (BFS-based). DFS-based topo sort. Union-Find: find with path compression, union by rank. Applications: course prerequisites, connected components.
topics.practice: Solve: Course Schedule I & II, Number of Connected Components, Redundant Connection, Alien Dictionary

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.topic: Full Stack Integration — React + Express + MongoDB project
topics.what_to_learn: Connecting frontend (React) to backend (Express API). Axios for HTTP from React. CORS setup on Express. Environment variables (.env). Deploying backend to Render/Railway. Deploying frontend to Vercel.
topics.practice: Build and deploy a MERN stack todo app. Host backend on Render, frontend on Vercel.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.topic: Dynamic Programming — 1D problems, memoization vs tabulation
topics.what_to_learn: DP philosophy: overlapping subproblems + optimal substructure. Top-down (memoization) vs bottom-up (tabulation). Space optimization. Classic 1D problems: Fibonacci, climbing stairs, house robber, word break.
topics.practice: Solve: Climbing Stairs, House Robber I & II, Coin Change, Word Break

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Why TypeScript? Static typing. Types: string, number, boolean, array, object, any, unknown, void. Interfaces vs Types. Generics basics. TypeScript with React (React.FC, event types). tsconfig.json.
topics.practice: Convert your Express API to TypeScript — add types for request params, response bodies, DB models

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: 2D DP table setup. Unique paths in a grid. Edit distance (Levenshtein). Longest Common Subsequence (LCS). Matrix chain multiplication concept. DP on strings pattern.
topics.practice: Solve: Unique Paths, Longest Common Subsequence, Edit Distance, Target Sum

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Why Docker? Container vs VM. Dockerfile: FROM, WORKDIR, COPY, RUN, EXPOSE, CMD. Building and running images. Docker volumes, networks. docker-compose for multi-container apps (app + DB).
topics.practice: Dockerize your Express + MongoDB app using docker-compose. Run it locally with one command.

days.title: CS Fundamentals — Memory Management + AI/ML Python

topics.subject: CS Fundamentals
topics.topic: Memory Management — stack, heap, garbage collection
topics.what_to_learn: Stack memory: function calls, local variables, LIFO. Heap memory: dynamic allocation, pointers. Memory leaks. Garbage collection algorithms: reference counting, mark and sweep, generational GC. How JS/Python/Java manage memory.
topics.practice: Write a note explaining: why does a circular reference cause a memory leak in reference counting? How does JS handle it?

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.topic: Python for ML — NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib
topics.what_to_learn: NumPy: ndarray, vectorized operations, broadcasting, reshape, dot product. Pandas: DataFrame, read_csv, loc/iloc, groupby, describe, merge. Matplotlib: line, bar, scatter plots. This is the foundation for all ML.
topics.practice: Load the Titanic CSV from Kaggle. Do EDA: survival rate by gender/class. Plot with Matplotlib.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: 0/1 Knapsack: classic problem, DP table setup, space optimization. Unbounded knapsack. Longest Increasing Subsequence: O(n²) DP, O(n log n) patience sorting. Variations: number of LIS, Russian doll envelopes.
topics.practice: Solve: 0/1 Knapsack, Coin Change 2, Longest Increasing Subsequence, Russian Doll Envelopes

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Why Next.js over CRA? File-based routing. getServerSideProps (SSR), getStaticProps (SSG), getStaticPaths. API routes (backend in Next.js). Image optimization. next/link and next/router. App Router (new).
topics.practice: Rebuild your React weather app in Next.js using SSR — fetch data server-side

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Trie (prefix tree) structure. Insert, search, startsWith operations. Space vs time trade-offs. Use cases: autocomplete, spell checking, IP routing. Compressed trie / Radix tree concept.
topics.practice: Solve: Implement Trie, Design Add and Search Words DS, Replace Words

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Sorting intervals by start time. Merge overlapping intervals. Insert interval. Non-overlapping intervals (greedy). Meeting rooms pattern.
topics.practice: Solve: Merge Intervals, Insert Interval, Non-overlapping Intervals, Meeting Rooms II

topics.subject: System Design
topics.what_to_learn: Why cache? Cache hit/miss. Redis vs Memcached. Cache invalidation strategies (LRU, LFU, TTL). Cache aside vs write-through vs write-behind. CDN for static assets. Cache stampede problem.
topics.practice: Design a caching layer for a news feed: what do you cache? For how long? How do you handle updates?

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.what_to_learn: ML workflow: data prep → train/test split → model training → evaluation. Linear Regression, Logistic Regression. Decision Trees. Random Forests. K-Means clustering. Evaluation metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC.
topics.practice: Train a Logistic Regression classifier on Titanic dataset. Get accuracy, confusion matrix, and F1 score.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Backtracking pattern: choose, explore, unchoose. Decision tree visualization. Subsets (power set), permutations, combinations. Pruning: how to cut branches early. N-Queens, Sudoku solver.
topics.practice: Solve: Subsets, Permutations, Combination Sum, Word Search, N-Queens, Letter Combinations of Phone Number

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Why test? Unit vs integration vs e2e tests. Jest basics: describe, it, expect, matchers. React Testing Library: render, screen, getByText, userEvent. Test coverage. TDD philosophy.
topics.practice: Write unit tests for your Express API endpoints and React components with at least 70% coverage

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Greedy strategy: make the locally optimal choice at each step. When greedy works (proving exchange argument). Activity selection, fractional knapsack, Huffman coding. Jump game pattern. Greedy vs DP.
topics.practice: Solve: Jump Game I & II, Gas Station, Hand of Straights, Merge Triplets, Partition Labels

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: HTTP polling vs WebSockets vs SSE. WebSocket handshake. Socket.io for real-time events. Rooms and namespaces. Use cases: chat, live notifications, collaborative editing.
topics.practice: Build a real-time chat app using Socket.io — users join rooms, see live messages

topics.subject: DSA
topics.topic: Mock Interview — 2 LeetCode problems under time pressure
topics.what_to_learn: Simulate real interview: pick 1 Medium + 1 Medium DSA problem. Set a 45-minute timer. Think aloud, talk through approach before coding. Review solution afterward.
topics.practice: Pick 2 random NeetCode Medium problems. Solve in 45 mins total. Watch NeetCode solution after.

topics.subject: Cloud (GCP)
topics.topic: GCP Networking — VPC, Load Balancing, Cloud CDN
topics.what_to_learn: VPC (Virtual Private Cloud): subnets, firewall rules, peering. Cloud Load Balancing types (HTTP(S), TCP/SSL, internal). Cloud CDN for caching static content globally. Cloud DNS. Private vs public IP in GCP.
topics.practice: Set up a VPC with custom subnets, deploy 2 VMs, configure firewall rules so they can talk to each other

topics.subject: DSA
topics.topic: MST — Kruskal's & Prim's, A* Algorithm concept
topics.what_to_learn: Minimum Spanning Tree: what it is and when it matters. Kruskal's using Union-Find. Prim's using priority queue. A* heuristic search (for pathfinding). Floyd-Warshall for all-pairs shortest paths.
topics.practice: Solve: Min Cost to Connect All Points, Network Becomes Disconnect, Swim in Rising Water

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.topic: Redis — caching in a full stack app
topics.what_to_learn: Set up Redis locally. redis npm client. Caching API responses: set, get, expire. Session storage with Redis. Rate limiting with Redis counters. Pub/Sub for real-time features.
topics.practice: Add Redis caching to your Express API — cache GET /users for 60 seconds, invalidate on POST/DELETE

topics.subject: DSA
topics.topic: Bit Manipulation — XOR tricks, bitmask DP
topics.what_to_learn: AND, OR, XOR, NOT, left/right shift. XOR properties (a^a=0, a^0=a). Finding single number, missing number with XOR. Counting set bits. Power of 2 check. Bitmask DP concept.
topics.practice: Solve: Single Number, Number of 1 Bits, Counting Bits, Reverse Bits, Sum of Two Integers

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: REST vs GraphQL trade-offs. Schema definition language. Queries, Mutations, Subscriptions. Resolvers. Apollo Server setup. Avoid over-fetching / under-fetching. When GraphQL shines (complex, graph-like data).
topics.practice: Build a GraphQL API with Apollo Server for your blog DB — queries for posts, users, comments

days.title: System Design — Message Queues + AI/ML Deep Learning

topics.subject: System Design
topics.topic: Message Queues — Kafka, RabbitMQ, async processing
topics.what_to_learn: Why message queues? Producer-consumer pattern. Kafka: topics, partitions, consumer groups, offsets. RabbitMQ: exchanges, queues, routing. At-least-once vs at-most-once vs exactly-once delivery. Dead letter queues.
topics.practice: Design an order processing system using Kafka: order → payment service → inventory service → notification service

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.what_to_learn: Perceptron → MLP. Forward pass, backpropagation, gradient descent. Activation functions (ReLU, Sigmoid, Softmax). Loss functions (MSE, Cross-entropy). Overfitting, dropout, batch normalization. PyTorch vs TensorFlow.
topics.practice: Build an MLP from scratch using PyTorch to classify MNIST digits — train for 5 epochs, get >95% accuracy

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Segment tree: range queries (sum, min, max) in O(log n). Build, update, query. Monotonic stack: finding next greater/smaller element. Largest rectangle in histogram.
topics.practice: Solve: Range Sum Query, Largest Rectangle in Histogram, Trapping Rain Water, Daily Temperatures

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Monolith vs microservices. Service decomposition strategies. Inter-service communication: REST vs gRPC vs message queues. Service discovery. API gateway pattern. Challenges: distributed transactions, observability.
topics.practice: Split your MERN app into 2 microservices (user-service + post-service). Add an API gateway using Express.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Attempt hard problems using patterns learned so far. Combine techniques: DP + binary search, Graph + heap, Backtracking + memoization. Focus on understanding approach, not memorizing code.
topics.practice: Attempt: Word Ladder, Median of Two Sorted Arrays, Serialize/Deserialize Binary Tree

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: What is CI/CD? Continuous Integration (run tests on every PR). Continuous Deployment (auto-deploy on merge). GitHub Actions: workflows, jobs, steps, actions. Building a pipeline: lint → test → build → deploy.
topics.practice: Add a GitHub Actions workflow to your MERN project — run Jest tests on every push to main

days.title: System Design Case Study + AI Agents

topics.subject: System Design
topics.topic: Design Netflix — CDN, video streaming, recommendations
topics.what_to_learn: Video streaming: encoding (HLS/DASH), CDN edge caching, adaptive bitrate. Content upload pipeline. Microservices breakdown. Cassandra for watch history. Kafka for events. Recommendation engine (ML-based). ElasticSearch for search.
topics.practice: Draw the architecture diagram for Netflix. Include: client → CDN → API gateway → microservices → DBs

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.what_to_learn: What is an AI agent? ReAct pattern (Reason + Act). Function/tool calling with LLM APIs. Building agent loops: LLM → tool → observation → LLM. LangChain / LlamaIndex basics. Memory types: in-context, vector store, database.
topics.practice: Build an agent using LangChain that can: search the web, read a URL, and summarize the content

topics.subject: DSA
topics.topic: Pattern Revision — all patterns so far
topics.what_to_learn: Review all patterns: arrays, strings, two pointers, sliding window, hashing, binary search, linked lists, trees, graphs, DP, backtracking, greedy, heaps, tries. Make a cheat sheet of when to use each.
topics.practice: Solve 3 Medium problems — pick one from each: Trees, Graphs, DP

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: React.memo, useMemo, useCallback — preventing unnecessary re-renders. Code splitting with React.lazy and Suspense. Virtual DOM and reconciliation. Profiler. Key prop importance. List virtualization (react-window).
topics.practice: Profile your React app. Identify 3 unnecessary re-renders and fix them using memo/useMemo/useCallback.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.topic: Number Theory for CP — primes, modular arithmetic, GCD
topics.what_to_learn: Sieve of Eratosthenes for primes. GCD (Euclidean algorithm). LCM. Modular arithmetic: (a+b)%m, (a*b)%m, modular exponentiation. Fermat's little theorem. Important in competitive programming.
topics.practice: Solve 2 Codeforces problems (Div. 2, A and B level) — focus on number theory

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities. SQL injection and prevention (parameterized queries). XSS (Cross-Site Scripting) and CSP headers. CSRF attacks and tokens. Rate limiting. Helmet.js for Node.js security headers. Input validation.
topics.practice: Audit your Express API for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities. Add Helmet.js, input validation, and rate limiting.

days.title: System Design — Design WhatsApp + AWS Intro

topics.subject: System Design
topics.topic: Design WhatsApp/Messenger — real-time messaging at scale
topics.what_to_learn: WebSockets for real-time chat. Message storage: Cassandra for time-series messages. User presence detection. Push notifications (APNs, FCM). End-to-end encryption concept. Fan-out problem for group messages. Media storage with CDN.
topics.practice: Design a messaging app for 100M users. Focus on: message delivery guarantee, offline handling, scaling strategy.

topics.subject: Cloud (AWS)
topics.topic: AWS Core Services — EC2, S3, RDS, IAM
topics.what_to_learn: AWS vs GCP — similarities and differences. EC2 (virtual machines), instance types, security groups. S3 (object storage), bucket policies. RDS (managed databases). IAM users, roles, policies. AWS CLI basics.
topics.practice: Create an AWS account. Launch an EC2 instance. Create an S3 bucket. Connect via SSH.

days.title: DSA Hard Sprint + Project Portfolio Work

topics.subject: DSA
topics.topic: LeetCode Hard Sprint — top interview questions
topics.what_to_learn: Focus: Trapping Rain Water (hard variant), Longest Valid Parentheses, Regular Expression Matching, Burst Balloons, Largest Rectangle in Histogram. Understand each approach thoroughly.
topics.practice: Solve 2 of these hard problems. Do not look at hints for first 25 minutes.

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.topic: Portfolio Project — plan and start building
topics.what_to_learn: Pick a meaningful project: AI-powered summarizer, cloud-deployed full-stack app, real-time collaboration tool. Plan: DB schema, API endpoints, React pages, AI features, deployment pipeline.
topics.practice: Set up the GitHub repo, project board, and basic scaffolding for your portfolio project

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Participate in a LeetCode Weekly/Biweekly contest or simulate one. Solve Q1 (easy), Q2 (medium), attempt Q3 (medium-hard). Build contest stamina and time management.
topics.practice: Solve last week's LeetCode contest — aim for 3 problems. Review editorial for Q4.

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Build the core backend for your portfolio project. Set up models, routes, auth, and deploy to Render/Railway with a real DB (PostgreSQL or MongoDB Atlas).
topics.practice: Complete backend with all CRUD endpoints + auth. Deploy and test with Postman.

topics.subject: Behavioral
topics.what_to_learn: STAR framework (Situation, Task, Action, Result). Prepare 5-7 strong stories. Common questions: Tell me about yourself, greatest strength/weakness, conflict with teammate, leadership example, failure you learned from. How to tailor for each company.
topics.practice: Write out STAR stories for: 1 leadership, 1 conflict, 1 failure, 1 innovation, 1 teamwork situation

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.what_to_learn: Convolutional layers, pooling, feature maps. Classic architectures: LeNet, VGG, ResNet. Transfer learning: using pretrained models. Image classification, object detection (YOLO concept). Practical with torchvision.
topics.practice: Fine-tune a pretrained ResNet-18 on a dataset of your choice (e.g., cats vs dogs). Get >90% validation accuracy.

topics.subject: System Design
topics.topic: Design Google Drive — file storage at scale
topics.what_to_learn: File chunking for large uploads. Blob storage (S3/GCS). Metadata DB (PostgreSQL). Sync protocol. Conflict resolution (last-write-wins vs OT). Sharing and permissions model. Deduplication using content hashing.
topics.practice: Design the upload flow for a 5GB file: chunking, progress tracking, resumable upload, storage strategy

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Build the React frontend for your portfolio project. Add routing with React Router v6. State management with Context/Zustand. Connect to your deployed backend. Add loading states and error handling.
topics.practice: Complete the frontend with all pages, connect to backend, add proper error boundaries

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Review the Blind 75 list. Identify any patterns or problems you haven't covered. Focus on unsolved problems: interval scheduling, advanced DP, complex graph problems. Aim to have solved all 75 by end of phase 1.
topics.practice: Solve 5 Blind 75 problems you haven't done yet. Cover different topics.

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Add an AI-powered feature to your project: auto-summarization using LLM API, smart search using embeddings, AI-generated tags, or a chatbot. This makes your portfolio stand out massively.
topics.practice: Add an AI summary feature to your project using OpenAI/Gemini API. Show it working in a demo video.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Simulate a 60-minute technical interview: 45 min DSA (2 problems) + 15 min system design + behavioral. Use Pramp or a friend. Focus on communication, edge cases, time/space complexity analysis.
topics.practice: Full mock interview on Pramp or with a peer. Score yourself honestly. Note 3 things to improve.

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Deploy the complete project. Write a professional README: problem statement, tech stack, architecture diagram, how to run locally, live demo link. Record a 2-minute demo video. Deploy to Vercel + Render.
topics.practice: Complete, deploy, and document your portfolio project. Share the GitHub link and live URL.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Binary Indexed Tree (Fenwick Tree): update and prefix sum in O(log n). Comparing with segment tree: simpler but less general. Sparse Table: range min/max queries in O(1) with O(n log n) preprocessing.
topics.practice: Implement BIT from scratch. Solve: Range Sum Query (Mutable), Count of Smaller Numbers After Self

topics.subject: Cloud (AWS)
topics.what_to_learn: Serverless functions: no server management, pay-per-execution. Lambda triggers (API Gateway, S3, SQS). Cold start problem. Lambda layers. Serverless Framework. Use cases: image resize on upload, scheduled jobs, microservices.
topics.practice: Deploy a serverless API using AWS Lambda + API Gateway. Trigger it with an S3 event to process uploads.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Bitmask DP: represent subsets as bitmasks. Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). Interval DP: burst balloons, matrix chain multiplication, optimal BST. These appear in senior/competitive rounds.
topics.practice: Solve: Burst Balloons, Strange Printer, Zuma Game. Understand why interval DP applies.

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.topic: NLP & Text Processing — transformers, BERT, embeddings
topics.what_to_learn: Tokenization. Word embeddings (Word2Vec, GloVe). Transformer architecture: attention mechanism, self-attention, positional encoding. BERT for classification, question answering. Sentence transformers for semantic similarity. Hugging Face library.
topics.practice: Use Hugging Face pipeline for sentiment analysis and zero-shot classification. Build a text summarizer.

days.title: System Design — Design Uber + DevOps Kubernetes

topics.subject: System Design
topics.what_to_learn: Geospatial indexing: QuadTree, S2 library, geohashing. Real-time driver location updates (WebSockets, server push). Matching algorithm (proximity search). Surge pricing model. Trip state machine. PostgreSQL with PostGIS extension.
topics.practice: Design real-time driver matching: how do you find the nearest 5 drivers within 2km for 10M active users?

topics.subject: DevOps
topics.what_to_learn: Container orchestration. K8s architecture: control plane, worker nodes, etcd. Core objects: Pod, ReplicaSet, Deployment, Service, Ingress, ConfigMap, Secret. kubectl commands. Scaling and rolling updates. Why K8s in production.

resources.name: TechWorld with Nana K8s Full Course

topics.practice: Deploy your Dockerized app to a local Kubernetes cluster (minikube). Set up Deployment + Service + Ingress.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: KMP algorithm for pattern matching in O(n+m). Failure function (prefix table). Rabin-Karp rolling hash for pattern search. Z-algorithm. Suffix arrays concept. These appear in competitive programming.
topics.practice: Implement KMP from scratch. Solve: Repeated Substring Pattern, Shortest Palindrome, Find Occurrences

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.what_to_learn: Vector embeddings for semantic search. Cosine similarity. Vector DB options: Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector. RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pipeline: embed documents → store → retrieve → augment prompt → generate. Use cases for production AI apps.
topics.practice: Build a RAG app: embed your own PDF → store in ChromaDB → ask questions about it using GPT

topics.subject: CS Fundamentals
topics.what_to_learn: Compilation pipeline: lexing → parsing (AST) → semantic analysis → optimization → code generation. Interpreted vs compiled vs JIT. Python GIL (Global Interpreter Lock). JVM and garbage collection. V8 JavaScript engine.
topics.practice: Understand what happens when you run: `python app.py` vs `node app.js` vs `g++ main.cpp`. Write a comparison.

topics.subject: Cloud (GCP)
topics.what_to_learn: BigQuery architecture: Dremel, Colossus, Jupiter network. Partitioned and clustered tables. SQL in BigQuery — standard SQL with extensions. External tables. Streaming inserts. BigQuery ML (train models with SQL). Cost optimization.
topics.practice: Query the BigQuery public dataset (github_repos or COVID). Run window functions and aggregation queries.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Thread-safe data structures. Mutex, semaphore, monitor. Race conditions. Deadlock: detection and prevention. Producer-consumer problem. Readers-writers problem. Java synchronized / Python threading module.
topics.practice: Implement a thread-safe LRU Cache. Solve LeetCode: Print in Order, H2O, Fizz Buzz Multithreaded

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) — managed K8s. Autopilot vs Standard mode. Deploying from GCR (Google Container Registry). Helm: package manager for K8s. Helm charts, values.yaml. Namespace isolation.
topics.practice: Deploy your app to GKE using Helm. Set up horizontal pod autoscaling (HPA).

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Strongly Connected Components (SCC): Kosaraju's algorithm, Tarjan's algorithm. Bridges and articulation points using Tarjan's. 2-SAT problem. These are competitive programming staples and asked at senior levels.
topics.practice: Implement Tarjan's SCC. Solve: Critical Connections in a Network, Number of Provinces

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.what_to_learn: ML lifecycle: experiment → train → evaluate → deploy → monitor → retrain. Model serving: REST API (Flask/FastAPI), TorchServe, TF Serving. Model versioning with MLflow. Data drift detection. A/B testing models. Feature stores.
topics.practice: Use MLflow to track experiments: log params, metrics, artifacts for 3 different ML models. Compare runs.

days.title: System Design — Design Search Engine + AWS Advanced

topics.subject: System Design
topics.what_to_learn: Web crawler: politeness (robots.txt, rate limiting), URL frontier (queue), DNS resolution, deduplication. Inverted index for search. TF-IDF and PageRank concepts. ElasticSearch for full-text search. Spell correction and autocomplete.
topics.practice: Design the inverted index data structure. How would you build autocomplete for Google Search with low latency?

topics.subject: Cloud (AWS)
topics.what_to_learn: ECS (Elastic Container Service): task definitions, services, clusters. Fargate: serverless containers (no EC2 management). EKS (managed Kubernetes on AWS). ECR (Elastic Container Registry). When ECS vs EKS vs Lambda.
topics.practice: Deploy your Dockerized app to AWS Fargate using ECS. Push image to ECR, create task definition.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: AVL tree rotations (left, right, left-right, right-left). Why red-black trees are preferred in practice (less rigid balancing). B-Tree: multi-way trees for disk storage. B+ Trees in databases (why leaves are linked lists). Practical impact on DB indexes.
topics.practice: Understand why PostgreSQL uses B+ trees for its default index. What changes if you use a hash index?

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: The three pillars of observability. Structured logging (JSON logs). Log aggregation: ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) or Loki + Grafana. Metrics with Prometheus. Distributed tracing with Jaeger / OpenTelemetry. Alerting rules.
topics.practice: Add Prometheus metrics to your Express app (request count, latency). Visualize in Grafana.

days.title: CS Fundamentals — Distributed Systems + AI/ML Production

topics.subject: CS Fundamentals
topics.what_to_learn: CAP theorem deep dive: consistency vs availability vs partition tolerance. Raft consensus algorithm (simplified). Eventual consistency. Vector clocks. Leader election. Google Spanner and how it bends CAP with TrueTime.
topics.practice: Explain: in a distributed DB split across 3 data centers, what happens during a network partition? Choose CP or AP and justify.

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.what_to_learn: LoRA and QLoRA for efficient fine-tuning. PEFT (Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning). Fine-tune a small model (GPT-2, LLaMA-3.2) on custom data using Hugging Face. Advanced prompt engineering: chain-of-thought, few-shot, self-consistency, ReAct.
topics.practice: Fine-tune GPT-2 on a dataset (e.g., your own text style) using Hugging Face Trainer. Generate samples.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Participate in a live or virtual contest. Apply all patterns. Focus on Q1-Q3. Analyze mistakes after. Track your rating over time — consistency beats cramming.
topics.practice: Complete a full virtual LeetCode contest. Review Q4 editorial even if you didn't solve it.

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.what_to_learn: Plan your second portfolio project — an AI-first app. Ideas: AI code reviewer, resume analyzer, meeting summarizer, document Q&A system. Tech stack: Next.js + FastAPI/Node + Vector DB + LLM API.
topics.practice: Plan the AI project: write the spec (what it does, tech stack, architecture). Set up repo.

days.title: Advanced System Design + AI Project Build

topics.subject: System Design
topics.topic: Design a Rate Limiter + API Gateway
topics.what_to_learn: Rate limiting algorithms: Token bucket, Leaky bucket, Fixed window, Sliding window log, Sliding window counter. Distributed rate limiting with Redis. API Gateway features: auth, rate limiting, routing, SSL termination, load balancing.
topics.practice: Implement a sliding window rate limiter using Redis in your Express API. Allow 100 requests/user/minute.

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.what_to_learn: Build the FastAPI/Node backend for your AI project. Set up vector DB. Implement the embedding pipeline. Create API endpoints for the AI features.
topics.practice: Complete the core AI pipeline — working embeddings + retrieval + LLM generation via API endpoint

topics.subject: Behavioral
topics.what_to_learn: Research your target companies: Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Atlassian, Flipkart, Swiggy, Zepto. Each company has a culture — align your stories. Amazon: Leadership Principles. Google: Googleyness. Practice answering in 2-3 minutes max. Record yourself.
topics.practice: Research 3 target companies. Write 2 tailored STAR stories for each. Practice saying them aloud.

topics.subject: Cloud (GCP/AWS)
topics.topic: Cloud Security — Identity, Secrets, Zero Trust
topics.what_to_learn: Principle of least privilege. IAM best practices: no root user, service accounts. Secret Manager (GCP) / AWS Secrets Manager for API keys. VPC Service Controls. Zero Trust networking. Cloud Armor (DDoS protection). Security Command Center.
topics.practice: Audit your GCP project for security issues. Fix: disable unused APIs, apply least-privilege IAM, enable audit logs.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.topic: Network Flow — Ford-Fulkerson, Max Flow Min Cut
topics.what_to_learn: Flow networks: source, sink, capacity, flow. Ford-Fulkerson with BFS (Edmonds-Karp). Max flow = Min cut theorem. Bipartite matching using max flow. Applications: matching problems, airline scheduling.
topics.practice: Implement Edmonds-Karp. Solve: Max Flow problem on USACO / Codeforces. Understand bipartite matching.

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Build the Next.js frontend for your AI project. Add streaming responses (SSE/WebSocket) if using LLM. Polish the UI. Add loading states, error handling. Write good copy explaining what the app does.
topics.practice: Complete the frontend. Record a 3-minute demo video showing the AI features working.

topics.subject: System Design
topics.topic: Design a Notification System at scale
topics.what_to_learn: Push vs pull notifications. Mobile push (APNs for iOS, FCM for Android). Email (SendGrid, SES). SMS (Twilio). Fan-out service for mass notifications. Priority queues (payment alert > promotional). Delivery guarantee with retry and dead-letter queue.
topics.practice: Design a notification system for a food delivery app. Handle: order confirmation, delivery updates, promos (10M users).

topics.subject: Behavioral
topics.what_to_learn: ATS-friendly resume format. Quantify impact: 'Reduced API latency by 40%' not 'worked on backend'. Projects section: title, tech stack, what problem it solves, link. LinkedIn: headline, summary, skills endorsements, GitHub pinned repos.
topics.practice: Finalize resume with 2 projects highlighted. Update LinkedIn. Pin best 3 repos on GitHub with good READMEs.

days.title: CS Fundamentals — Formal Languages + AI/ML Reinforcement Learning

topics.subject: CS Fundamentals
topics.what_to_learn: Finite Automata (DFA, NFA). Regular languages and regex. Context-free grammars. Pumping lemma (conceptual). Turing machines and computability. Practical: understanding regex deeply, parser concepts.
topics.practice: Write regex patterns for: email validation, URL parsing, log format extraction. Implement a simple DFA.

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.what_to_learn: RL framework: agent, environment, state, action, reward. Markov Decision Processes (MDP). Q-Learning and Deep Q-Networks (DQN). Policy gradient methods. OpenAI Gym for environments. RLHF (used to train ChatGPT).
topics.practice: Train a DQN agent to play CartPole using OpenAI Gym + PyTorch. Visualize reward over episodes.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Participate in a Codeforces Div. 2 contest (or virtual). Target: solve A + B + C. Practice speed on simpler problems. Read fast, think algorithmically, code cleanly.
topics.practice: Complete a Codeforces Div. 2 contest. Aim for Specialist rating (1400+) over the next weeks.

topics.subject: System Design
topics.what_to_learn: Review all 8 system designs covered so far. Make concise 1-page notes for each. Practice explaining each in 5 minutes. Focus on: key components, bottlenecks, scaling approach, data model.
topics.practice: Do a timed 5-minute verbal/written explanation of 3 systems: URL shortener, WhatsApp, Netflix

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.topic: tRPC & Prisma ORM — modern full stack
topics.what_to_learn: Prisma: type-safe ORM for TypeScript. Schema definition, migrations, CRUD with type safety. tRPC: end-to-end type-safe API (no REST schema needed). How tRPC eliminates API mismatches. Using with Next.js.
topics.practice: Rebuild your Express CRUD API using Prisma + tRPC + Next.js. Compare DX to vanilla Express.

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.what_to_learn: Deploy your AI project to production. Optimize: caching LLM responses, batching embedding calls, streaming for UX. Add usage tracking. Monitor costs. Write a blog post or LinkedIn post about what you built.
topics.practice: Deploy AI project. Write a 500-word LinkedIn post about it with demo video. Post it.

days.title: System Design — Design Stock Exchange + AWS Data

topics.subject: System Design
topics.topic: Design a Stock Exchange / Trading System
topics.what_to_learn: Order book (bid/ask). Matching engine (price-time priority). Market orders vs limit orders. Ultra-low latency requirements (microseconds). Event sourcing for trade history. CQRS pattern. Real-time price feed with WebSocket.
topics.practice: Design the order matching engine. How do you guarantee fairness, atomicity, and handle 1M orders/second?

topics.subject: Cloud (AWS)
topics.topic: AWS Data Services — Redshift, Glue, Athena
topics.what_to_learn: AWS Redshift: columnar data warehouse. Athena: serverless SQL on S3. Glue: ETL service and data catalog. Kinesis: real-time streaming. Data lake architecture. Comparing to GCP BigQuery.
topics.practice: Set up an S3 data lake. Use Glue Crawler to catalog it. Query with Athena. Compare cost to BigQuery.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Google: heavy on graphs, DP, string processing. Amazon: focus on real-world scenarios, OOP design. Meta: heavy DP and array manipulation. Microsoft: graphs and BFS/DFS. Review company-tagged LeetCode problems.
topics.practice: Solve 5 Google-tagged LeetCode problems (medium/hard). Note patterns specific to Google rounds.

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Finding good first issues. Reading and understanding a large codebase. Fork → clone → branch → fix → PR. Writing good PR descriptions. Code review etiquette. How OSS contributions look on a resume.
topics.practice: Find and submit a PR to an open-source project — even a small bug fix or docs improvement counts

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Simulate a full technical loop: Round 1 (DSA), Round 2 (DSA), Round 3 (System Design), Round 4 (Behavioral). Use Pramp, Interviewing.io, or practice with a friend. Focus on communication under pressure.
topics.practice: Complete 2 mock DSA rounds and 1 system design mock this week. Record if possible.

topics.subject: System Design
topics.topic: Low Level Design — OOP, Design Patterns
topics.what_to_learn: LLD (Low Level Design) vs HLD. SOLID principles. Design patterns: Singleton, Factory, Observer, Strategy, Decorator, Facade. UML class diagrams. How to approach LLD interviews: classes, interfaces, relationships.
topics.practice: Design a Parking Lot system in LLD. Draw class diagram. Implement in Java or Python.

days.title: CS Fundamentals — CPU Architecture + AI Ethics

topics.subject: CS Fundamentals
topics.what_to_learn: Instruction pipeline. Cache hierarchy (L1, L2, L3) and cache miss cost. Branch prediction. SIMD instructions (vectorization). Memory bandwidth. Why cache-friendly algorithms matter. Amdahl's Law.
topics.practice: Benchmark two matrix multiplication implementations: naive vs cache-friendly. Measure the difference.

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.what_to_learn: Types of AI bias: training data bias, algorithmic bias, measurement bias. Fairness metrics: equal opportunity, demographic parity. Explainability: LIME, SHAP. AI safety: alignment problem. Responsible AI practices. GDPR implications for ML.
topics.practice: Audit your ML model for demographic bias. Use Fairlearn to compute fairness metrics across groups.

topics.subject: System Design
topics.topic: LLD — Design Snake and Ladder / Chess / Elevator
topics.what_to_learn: Practice LLD interview questions: Snake and Ladder (state machine), Chess (piece hierarchy + OOP), Elevator System (scheduling + state). Focus on: extensibility, SOLID, appropriate use of design patterns.
topics.practice: Design and implement a full Chess game in OOP (pieces, board, move validation, check detection)

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: What is WebAssembly (WASM)? Running C/Rust in the browser. Edge functions (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge). Cold start elimination. Use cases: heavy computation in browser, ultra-low latency API. Deno and Bun as Node alternatives.
topics.practice: Deploy a Cloudflare Worker that proxies and transforms an API response. Benchmark latency vs regular serverless.

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Event streaming with Kafka or Redis Streams. Time-series data storage (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB). Aggregation pipelines. Real-time dashboard with WebSocket push. Recharts / Chart.js / D3 for visualization.
topics.practice: Build a real-time analytics dashboard: simulate events, stream to backend, aggregate, display live charts

topics.subject: Cloud (GCP)
topics.topic: GCP Data Engineering — Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Dataproc
topics.what_to_learn: Cloud Pub/Sub: messaging for event streaming. Dataflow: Apache Beam-based stream/batch processing. Dataproc: managed Hadoop/Spark. Building a data pipeline: source → Pub/Sub → Dataflow → BigQuery → Looker Studio.
topics.practice: Create a Pub/Sub topic. Publish messages from Cloud Run. Subscribe and process with a Dataflow template.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Two hard LeetCode problems under time pressure. Think out loud. After each: analyze time/space, discuss edge cases, suggest optimizations. Practice recovering when stuck.
topics.practice: Solve 2 hard LeetCode problems — Alien Dictionary and Longest Increasing Path in Matrix

topics.subject: Behavioral
topics.what_to_learn: Polish your top 10 STAR stories. Practice conciseness — each under 3 minutes. Prepare thoughtful questions to ask the interviewer. Research company values, recent news, products. Practice 'Tell me about yourself' — 90 second pitch.
topics.practice: Record yourself answering 10 behavioral questions. Watch it back. Improve pacing and clarity.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.topic: Advanced CP — divide and conquer, sqrt decomposition
topics.what_to_learn: Divide and conquer: merge sort tree, closest pair of points. Mo's algorithm: sqrt decomposition for offline queries. Persistent data structures concept. Heavy-Light Decomposition (HLD) for tree queries.
topics.practice: Solve 2 Codeforces problems involving Mo's algorithm or divide and conquer.

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.what_to_learn: Time series: trend, seasonality, noise. ARIMA model. Prophet (Facebook). LSTM for time series. Feature engineering for TS: lag features, rolling statistics. Evaluation: MAE, RMSE, MAPE. Applications: demand forecasting, stock prediction.
topics.practice: Forecast electricity demand using a public dataset. Compare Prophet vs LSTM vs ARIMA. Plot predictions.

topics.subject: System Design
topics.what_to_learn: Video upload pipeline: transcoding (FFmpeg), adaptive bitrate streaming (HLS), CDN distribution. Metadata DB. Recommendation system. Comments and like system at scale. View count (eventual consistency). Search with ElasticSearch.
topics.practice: Design the video transcoding pipeline: what services, queues, and storage would you use for 500 hours of uploads/minute?

topics.subject: Cloud (AWS)
topics.what_to_learn: AWS Cost Explorer. Reserved vs Spot vs On-Demand instances. S3 Intelligent-Tiering. CloudFront for CDN. Auto Scaling groups. Trusted Advisor recommendations. FinOps culture. Well-Architected Framework (5 pillars).
topics.practice: Review your AWS account against the Well-Architected Framework. Identify 3 cost/performance improvements.

days.title: CS Fundamentals — Type Theory + AI/ML GenAI

topics.subject: CS Fundamentals
topics.what_to_learn: Static vs dynamic typing. Strong vs weak typing. Type inference. Functional programming: pure functions, immutability, higher-order functions, monads concept. OOP vs FP trade-offs. When Rust's ownership model matters.
topics.practice: Rewrite a data processing pipeline in a functional style (using map/filter/reduce, no loops, no mutation)

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.topic: Generative AI — Diffusion Models, Image Generation
topics.what_to_learn: How diffusion models work (forward diffusion, denoising). Stable Diffusion architecture. CLIP for text-image understanding. ControlNet. Generating images with HuggingFace Diffusers library. Text-to-speech (TTS) and voice cloning basics.
topics.practice: Generate images using Stable Diffusion with Diffusers library. Try text-to-image, img2img, and inpainting.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Full mock: 2 DSA (45 min), 1 System Design (45 min), 1 LLD (30 min). Use Interviewing.io or organize with a peer. Debrief after: strengths, weaknesses, areas to work on.
topics.practice: Full mock interview loop. Score yourself 1-5 on: problem solving, code quality, communication, system design depth.

topics.subject: Behavioral
topics.what_to_learn: Where to apply: company career pages, LinkedIn, Instahyre (India), AngelList/Wellfound, Cutshort. Referrals (2-3x response rate). Cold outreach on LinkedIn. Tracking applications in a spreadsheet. Following up properly.
topics.practice: Apply to 10 jobs today. Use 3 channels: direct career page, LinkedIn, referral outreach. Track in spreadsheet.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Look at your LeetCode wrong answers and notes. What pattern keeps tripping you up? Spend this day on that topic only — graph flows? Complex DP? BST operations? Deep, focused practice beats broad reviewing.
topics.practice: Pick your weakest DSA topic. Solve 6 problems exclusively from that category.

topics.subject: Cloud (GCP)
topics.topic: GCP ML Services — Vertex AI, AutoML
topics.what_to_learn: Vertex AI: unified ML platform. AutoML for training without code. Vertex AI Workbench (managed notebooks). Model serving with Vertex Endpoints. MLOps on GCP: pipelines, model registry, monitoring. Generative AI on Vertex (Gemini API).
topics.practice: Train an AutoML text classifier on Vertex AI. Deploy the model to an endpoint and call it via REST API.

topics.subject: System Design
topics.topic: Design a Payment System / Stripe-like platform
topics.what_to_learn: Payment flow: initiate → process → confirm. Idempotency keys to prevent duplicate charges. Retry logic. Ledger system (double-entry bookkeeping). PCI-DSS compliance basics. Webhook delivery guarantees. Reconciliation.
topics.practice: Design idempotency in a payment API. How do you handle: user double-clicks pay button? Network timeout? Bank timeout?

topics.subject: Full Stack
topics.what_to_learn: Integrating a real payment gateway. Stripe SDK: PaymentIntent, Checkout Session, webhooks. Razorpay for India. Handling webhooks securely (signature verification). Test cards. Subscription and billing setup.
topics.practice: Add Stripe payments to your full stack project — checkout, success/failure pages, webhook handling

topics.subject: CS Fundamentals
topics.what_to_learn: Symmetric (AES) vs asymmetric (RSA) encryption. Hashing: SHA-256, bcrypt, salt. Digital signatures. TLS/SSL: handshake process, certificates, CA. Zero-knowledge proofs concept. How HTTPS protects your data.
topics.practice: Implement: RSA key pair generation, AES encryption of a message, SHA-256 hashing. Compare outputs with openssl.

topics.subject: Cloud
topics.topic: Cloud Certification Prep — GCP ACE or AWS SAA
topics.what_to_learn: GCP Associate Cloud Engineer (ACE) or AWS Solutions Architect Associate (SAA). Review all services studied. Do practice exams. Understand pricing tiers and when to use each service. Multi-region and high availability patterns.
topics.practice: Do 50 ACE or SAA practice questions. Score yourself. Review every wrong answer with documentation.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Check which NeetCode 150 problems remain unsolved. Prioritize: Hard problems first, then Medium you've avoided. Complete the list. This is the gold standard for FAANG preparation.
topics.practice: Solve remaining NeetCode 150 problems. Aim to have 130+ done by end of day.

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.what_to_learn: Common ML interview questions: bias-variance tradeoff, regularization (L1 vs L2), gradient vanishing/exploding, batch vs stochastic gradient descent, why attention works, RLHF explained, transformer architecture. Be able to explain clearly.
topics.practice: Answer 20 ML interview questions from the list. Write answers without looking. Then check.

days.title: Full System Design Mock + Leetcode Hard

topics.subject: System Design
topics.what_to_learn: Do a fully timed (45 min) system design on a prompt you haven't prepared: 'Design a ride-sharing surge pricing system' or 'Design a distributed logging system'. Practice structured thinking: clarify → estimate → high-level → DB → scale.
topics.practice: Timed 45-min system design: Design a distributed job scheduler like AWS Batch or Airflow

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Company-specific hard problems. Amazon hard: tree serialization, graph shortest path variants. Google hard: string processing, complex DP. Focus on your top 2 target companies.
topics.practice: Solve 3 hard problems tagged by your target company. Read editorial for any you don't solve.

days.title: DevOps Deep Dive + AI/ML Projects Review

topics.subject: DevOps
topics.what_to_learn: What is IaC? Terraform: providers, resources, variables, outputs, state file. Write Terraform to provision: GCS bucket, Cloud Run service, PostgreSQL. Plan vs apply. Terraform modules. GitOps workflow with Terraform.
topics.practice: Write Terraform code to provision a full GCP environment: VPC, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, GCS bucket.

topics.subject: AI/ML
topics.topic: AI/ML Projects — final polish and documentation
topics.what_to_learn: Review all AI/ML projects built. Ensure each has: clean README, working demo, architecture diagram, performance metrics documented. Prepare to talk about them in interviews — what problem, what approach, what results, what would you do differently.
topics.practice: Write a 1-page case study for each ML project. Problem → Solution → Results → Learnings.

topics.subject: Behavioral
topics.what_to_learn: How to write effective connection requests. Cold outreach to engineers and recruiters at target companies. How to ask for referrals respectfully. Alumni network. Discord and Slack communities for Indian developers.
topics.practice: Send 10 personalized LinkedIn connection requests to engineers at target companies. Follow up on any applications.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Random problem from NeetCode. No hints. 25 minutes. Clean code. Complexity analysis. Then review. This daily practice keeps you sharp during application period.
topics.practice: Solve 3 random NeetCode medium problems. No skipping. Time yourself.

topics.subject: DSA
topics.what_to_learn: Speed round: 10 medium LeetCode problems across different topics. Aim for 15-20 mins each. This builds interview stamina and confidence.
topics.practice: 10 medium LeetCode problems today — 2 each from: arrays, trees, graphs, DP, and strings.
